dinner.name: Pakistani Chicken Biryani (Layered Spiced Rice with Chicken)
dinner.description: Fragrant layered rice with chicken, saffron and aromatic spices - complex Pakistani dinner classic
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron, steeped in 100ml warm milk
Fresh cilantro and mint for garnish
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, ginger paste, garlic, 1/2 tsp garam masala, turmeric, chili powder; let sit 30 minutes
Fry onions in ghee until golden brown; remove half for garnish, crush remaining
Heat 1 tbsp ghee in large pot; add bay leaves, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves
Add marinated chicken with yogurt; cook 5 minutes
Add tomato paste, dried plums, green chilies; cook 10 minutes until chicken is half-cooked
Layer in pot: half the chicken mixture, then half the rice
Layer remaining chicken, then remaining rice
Sprinkle saffron milk, remaining garam masala, julienned ginger over top
Cover tightly with foil then lid; cook on high heat 3-4 minutes until steam forms
Reduce heat to low, cook 45-50 minutes (dum pukht method)
Let rest 10 minutes before opening; fluff with fork
dinner.notes: The dum pukht (closed pot) method is essential for proper biryani. Dried plums add authentic Pakistani flavor
dinner.fun_fact: Pakistani biryani is spicier and uses dried plums unique to Pakistan, reflecting distinct culinary traditions of Mughal courts of Lahore
